_doc: Q4 2026 calendar for the planner (PROPOSED, gap G5). Dates PT. Sources: USPS 2026 holiday shipping dates (usps.com/holiday, Sep 22 2026 release); US federal calendar. 'ship_days' per product must come from product_profiles (field to add) or Shopify delivery profiles (read-only). No own Q4 data exists yet (own posts span 2026-09-04..10-12), so phase rules are hypotheses to test in experiment slots.

levers: Christmas music allowed (own Sep-Oct winners used it)
deal framing in caption only (no fake prices on screen)
'arrives before Christmas' urgency only if true

gift_cutoff_rule: gift_cutoff = 2026-12-25 - (product.processing_days + product.ship_days) - 1 buffer day (dropship lanes are not USPS; USPS dates are the floor for domestic stock). If either field is unknown, the planner must not claim pre-Christmas delivery.
